will_defaults: I will practice communication intentionally for the outcome I chose.
I will keep showing up even when speaking or expressing myself feels uncomfortable.
will_not: I will not avoid practice because I feel awkward or imperfect.
I will not confuse occasional effort with consistent communication growth.
I will not let fear of judgment decide whether I express myself clearly.
reality_anchors: Clear communication improves through repetition, feedback, and deliberate practice.
